title: Pin UTF-8 for frozen-chain audit output
failure_signature: The recursive proposal loader found all 320 rows, then the Windows cp1252 console raised UnicodeEncodeError while printing a title containing a Maori macron.
trigger_preconditions: Complete frozen-chain JSON contained non-ASCII text
Python stdout inherited a cp1252 console encoding
Audit attempted direct human-readable row output
candidate_workaround: Set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 for the bounded read-only audit and preserve Unicode source text without transliteration.
recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 stdout before printing family ledgers or cultural-language text on Windows.
rollback: Discard the truncated display only, retain the encoding failure, leave source files untouched, and rerun the same read-only loader with explicit UTF-8.
protected_gates: No cultural-language normalization by software convenience
scope_boundary: This method addresses console encoding only and supplies no Maori authority, cultural ratification, scientific evidence, identity claim, or independent reproduction. Maori concepts remain under Maori authority.
